arguments.where_clause: CAST(strftime('%H', transactions.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 4
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction whose timestamp falls from 01:00 up to and including 04:59, on any day.
assumptions: Night is the window you gave, 01:00 to 04:59 inclusive, which covers hours 01, 02, 03 and 04 of the stored timestamp.
Times are read as stored in transactions.date, with no time zone conversion.
